pkg._: 2026-05-17: removed '*.js' glob from scripts. pkg auto-includes any .js statically required from server.js (entry point), so cleanup/debug_log/emule_api/security/tmdb_api/utils/etc. still get bytecoded. The wildcard was ALSO matching client-side files (poster_hero, init, cinema_player, etc.) which are served raw to the browser via /player.js. Bytecoding them prevented fs.readFileSync from returning their text, so the /player.js bundle was empty and the home page never enriched cards with TMDB posters. Now those files live only in 'assets' (below) and stay readable.
